arguments.command:
set -e
SRC="/home/openclaw/.openclaw/agents/main/sessions/"
DST="/home/openclaw/.openclaw/workspace/sessions/"
mkdir -p "$DST"
# Use rsync to copy new/changed files and list them
COPIED=$(rsync -av --ignore-existing "$SRC" "$DST" | tail -n +2 | awk '{print $2}')
# Also copy updated files (newer) using -u
UPDATED=$(rsync -av -u "$SRC" "$DST" | tail -n +2 | awk '{print $2}')
FILES=$(echo -e "$COPIED\n$UPDATED" | sort | uniq | grep -v '^$' || true)
if [ -z "$FILES" ]; then
  echo "No new or modified files to sync."
else
  cd "$DST/.."  # go to workspace root
  git add .
  git commit -m "Sync session transcripts"
  git push
  echo "Synced files:"
  echo "$FILES"
fi

set -e
SRC="/home/openclaw/.openclaw/agents/main/sessions"

# find .jsonl files (including .trajectory.jsonl) and copy if newer or missing
FILES=$(find "$SRC" -type f \( -name "*.jsonl" -o -name "*.trajectory.jsonl" \) -printf "%p\n")
SYNCED=""
for f in $FILES; do
  rel=${f#$SRC/}
  dest="$DST/$rel"
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$dest")"
  if [ ! -e "$dest" ] || [ "$f" -nt "$dest" ]; then
    cp -p "$f" "$dest"
    SYNCED+="$rel\n"
  fi
done
if [ -z "$SYNCED" ]; then
  echo "No new or modified files to sync."
else
  cd "$DST/.."
  git add .
  git commit -m "Sync session transcripts"
  git push
  echo "Synced files:"
  echo -e "$SYNCED"
fi

arguments.command:
set -e

mkdir -p "$DST"
TMPFILE=$(mktemp)
# find .jsonl files
find "$SRC" -type f \( -name "*.jsonl" -o -name "*.trajectory.jsonl" \) | while read -r f; do
  rel=${f#${SRC}/}

  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$dest")"
  if [ ! -e "$dest" ] || [ "$f" -nt "$dest" ]; then
    cp -p "$f" "$dest"
    echo "$rel" >> "$TMPFILE"
  fi
done
if [ -s "$TMPFILE" ]; then
  cd "$DST/.."
  git add .
  git commit -m "Sync session transcripts"
  git push
  echo "Synced files:"
  cat "$TMPFILE"
else
  echo "No new or modified files to sync."
fi
